summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform 5.6.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a React widget-platform library with a single runtime dependency on lodash.debounce, but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js],...)`. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB `@bun @bun-cjs` blob comprising a rotating string-array dispatcher (obfuscator.io-style: `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`, opaque `_0xXXXX` identifiers, >2000-entry mixed constant array) with no readable code and no relation to the advertised widget/UI purpose. Running the payload under Bun rather than Node evades Node-based scanners that inspect the package's resolved code. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time execution of attacker-controlled, obfuscated code on every machine that runs `npm install`, delivered under a reputable vendor scope (@servicetitan) whose UI-library purpose does not require a second language runtime — consistent with a scope/account compromise or tampered release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
